name: Terminal Replay
description: A terminal window that types out commands after a prompt and prints their output line by line.

props.name: lines
props.description: The session, in order. Commands are typed after the prompt with a light syntax tint; output lines appear whole, in their tone.

props.name: title
props.description: Centred in the title bar, and the accessible name of the scrolling body.

props.name: typingSpeed
props.description: Average milliseconds per typed character. Each keystroke varies a little around it.

props.name: lineDelay
props.description: Pause before a command starts and before its output, in milliseconds. Consecutive output lines follow at about a third of this.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Waits until the window is scrolled into view before typing. When false it starts on mount.

props.name: loop
props.description: Starts again a few seconds after the last line.

props.name: sound
props.description: Plays a faint synthesised tick for each typed character.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the window. It is h-80 by default; the body scrolls and follows the newest line.
